compression.qualification: Threshold-tuned validation scores are optimistic. Additional JPEG compression of C23-derived crops. PSNR compares decoded RGB crops; JPEG bytes are crop sizes, not video bitrate.

analysis.qualification: Descriptive validation intervals conditional on selected ridge penalties and thresholds; excludes selection uncertainty. Intervals are unadjusted across the representation panel.

jpeg_q40.scaling: Training-compressed-feature mean and population standard deviation
jpeg_q40.alpha_selection: Mean validation detection/source BA at threshold 0.5
jpeg_q40.threshold_rule: Maximize video detection BA on matched-quality validation
jpeg_q40.threshold_ties: Closest to 0.5, then smaller threshold; tolerance 1e-12
jpeg_q40.scope_note: Planned E02 known-quality control, prepared after exploratory reference-probe validation and before test scoring.
jpeg_q40.qualification: Validation-selected results are optimistic. Matched-quality adaptation is distinct from reference-trained compression retention. Original and adapted probes use different threshold selection domains; AUROC and fake-only attribution do not depend on the detection threshold. Five shuffles are diagnostics, not a formal significance test.
jpeg_q40.resource_qualification: Timer includes backbone loading, extraction, fitting and per-probe writes after input audits. GPU figures use the PyTorch allocator; system RAM is unmeasured.

dinov2_extraction.normalization: ImageNet RGB normalization; probe scaling uses training only
dinov2_extraction.qualification: Frozen backbone; common 224x224 study crops; no additional geometry. Timer includes decoding and cache writes, excludes model loading. No test predictions or classifier fitting.

qualification: Contains aggregate metrics and provenance, not raw predictions, images, feature arrays or model parameters. Bootstrap intervals condition on selected models and thresholds. Seed SD is descriptive. Source LF hashes account for repository text normalization.
